meta.title: Web Locker
meta.description: Covers the Web UI with a lock screen after idle timeout or a manual action, so a passer-by cannot read the screen. Background work keeps running.

overlay.title: Screen locked
overlay.hint: Click anywhere or press any key to unlock

idleSeconds.label: Idle lock timeout (seconds)
idleSeconds.help: Lock the screen after this many seconds without mouse or keyboard activity. 0 disables auto-lock.

password.label: Unlock password
password.help: If set, the password is required to unlock. Leave empty to unlock by click or keypress.

lockOnBlur.label: Lock when tab loses focus
lockOnBlur.help: Lock immediately when you switch to another tab or window.

showClock.label: Show clock on lock screen
showClock.help: Display the current time on the lock screen.

showManualButton.label: Show manual lock button
showManualButton.help: Add a 'Lock screen' action to the sidebar footer.
